transcript.content: Hello. What brings you into the clinic to see me today?

I finally came in because my appetite has been really up and down for months. Some nights I skip dinner and end up losing weight without trying. Other times I just pick at crackers or cereal because cooking for myself feels kind of pointless.
Aside from your appetite, how has your overall mood been lately?
I’m not really sure what you mean by overall mood. I’ve mostly been focused on the eating issue, honestly.
Have you noticed that you've lost interest or pleasure in activities you normally enjoy?
Yeah, I think so. I still water my garden and go to book club sometimes, but it all feels pretty flat. A lot of the time I leave early, or I just don’t get around to going at all.
Did a specific event or major life change occur around the time these changes started?
Yes. It started around the time my divorce was finalized—about a year and seven months ago.
Before your divorce, had you ever gone through a period where you felt like this?
I’m not sure. I mean, I’ve had hard times before, but I don’t know if they were like this.
How has your sleep been during this time?

I get to bed at a reasonable time, usually. But I keep waking up around four in the morning, thinking about bills, work notes, or the divorce. Then I’m just lying there exhausted until the alarm goes off.
During this time, have you been feeling down, sad, or depressed most days?
I’m not really sure how to answer that. I’ve been having a hard time, but I don’t know if I’d say I feel sad or depressed most days.
How have your energy levels been throughout the day?
Even when my caseload isn’t especially heavy, I feel like I’m dragging myself through the hospital. By the time I get home, I’m too tired to cook, stretch, or even answer personal messages.
Have you noticed any difficulty concentrating or making decisions lately?

Yes. During case reviews, I’ll reread the same notes several times before they sink in. And even simple decisions—like which client to call back first, or what to buy for dinner—can take me an embarrassing amount of time.
Have you been struggling with feelings of worthlessness, or feeling excessively guilty about things lately?
I keep replaying the marriage and wondering if I failed at something basic. Part of me knows it’s more complicated than that, but I still blame myself a lot.
Have you ever been diagnosed with or received treatment for depression in the past?
No, I haven’t been diagnosed or treated for it before.
Have you had any thoughts that life isn't worth living, or thoughts of hurting yourself?
I don’t have a plan to hurt myself. But sometimes I catch myself thinking it might be a relief not to wake up. That scares me, honestly—if one of my clients said that, I’d take it seriously.
